question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.**

Coming from the movie around midnight, the boys **__hit the sack__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"went to sleep."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "hit the sack"** means to go to sleep. (सोना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I've got to get up early tomorrow, so I'm going to **hit the sack**__.*
 
 
 
• It is a colloquial expression used in informal settings.
 
• The word **"sack"** refers to a bed or a sleeping bag.
 
• The phrase is believed to have originated from the practice of hitting a cloth sack filled with hay to make a bed.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

2f:Ta2
